approvedDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 tab y-position: figma master places it at y=807 inside the 844-tall figma frame; impl renders it via _layout Tabs at the viewport bottom (sticky), which lands 40px lower due to extra impl content overflow. UX-equivalent — sticky tab bar always sits at the viewport bottom. Approved 2026-05-28.
Inactive 2-tab segmented label weight: master spec = 700 (matches selected); some figma frame instances render 500 for inactive. Impl follows the master canon. Approved 2026-05-28.

Hero-card amount unit (USD suffix) — figma seeds amount '≈ 8,540.97' but mock renders the live ≈ 9,911.87 USD sum of all 10 mock balances. Different amount text widths shift the USD suffix by ~12px on the right side of the flex-baseline row. Visually identical layout (amount + space + USD), drift is data-driven. Approved 2026-05-28.

Hero-card USD suffix baseline alignment: items-baseline on the amount+USD flex row makes USD baseline track the amount text baseline. Different fonts (PlusJakartaSans vs HarmonyOS Sans TC fallback) shift the baseline by ~7px even at the same fontSize. Visually unified bottom edge. Approved 2026-05-28.

Frame-vs-content extraction discrepancy: Figma reports the 64-px label TEXT FRAME's x (20), impl extract-impl reports the rendered text content's x (38 — same text centered within the same 64-px frame). Visually identical (icon + centered label below). Approved 2026-05-28.
Same frame-vs-content discrepancy as 存款. Approved 2026-05-28.

Section header lineHeight: figma SGB seeds 16.41 (compact) but SectionLabel master ships 24 (matches home/cards section headers). Cross-frame inconsistency in figma; impl follows master. Approved 2026-05-28.

Figma master uses fontWeight 900 (HarmonyOS Sans TC Black) for currency-account labels. The app ships only Plus Jakarta Sans Bold (700) bundled as the brand face — RN-Web clamps Black to 700. Visual difference imperceptible at 12px. Approved 2026-05-28.
Same weight-900 → 700 clamp as 美元账户. Approved 2026-05-28.

Tx-section sub-row 查看全部 link: impl's flex justify-between layout positions the link 14px further right than the figma frame's reported x. The right edge (chevron-right) aligns with the section's right margin in both — only the text frame's reported leading-edge differs, due to flex-end gap distribution. Visually equivalent. Approved 2026-05-28.
